candidates.title: A Successful Replay Is Not a Standing Right to Execute
candidates.title_zh: 重放曾经成功，不等于仍有执行资格
candidates.researchQuestion: 当一个数字员工曾经成功执行过一条可复用记忆时，下一次重放需要哪些新鲜证据，才能证明它仍然适用于当前状态、仍获业务授权，并且其外部效果可以被安全核对？
candidates.coreProposition: 历史成功只能把一条记忆变成重放候选；每次执行仍须重新证明制品与状态兼容、请求与权限有效，并在调用后独立核对外部效果。重放准入、业务授权和效果验证是三个不能互相替代的事实。

sections.heading: Replay Is Worth Keeping Because It Reduces Repeated Cost
sections.heading_zh: 重放值得保留，因为它确实降低重复成本

sections.heading: Similarity Finds a Candidate, Not Permission
Eligibility Must Be Reproved for This Run
sections.heading_zh: 执行资格必须在本次运行重新证明

sections.heading: An Auditable Replay Chain Needs Six Identities
sections.heading_zh: 一条可审计重放链需要六种身份

sections.heading: Compatibility Can Pass While Business Authority Fails
sections.heading_zh: 兼容通过，仍可能没有业务授权

sections.heading: A Successful Call Does Not Prove a Single Effect
sections.heading_zh: 调用成功，也不能证明效果只发生一次

evidenceClaims.claim: Across 145 matched second-pass tasks, the study reports 91.2 percent completion, median 20,370 tokens, and median 127.5 seconds, versus 91.8 percent, 586,386 tokens, and 315.7 seconds for the comparison method.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，在145个匹配的第二遍任务上，完成率为91.2%，中位令牌约20,370，中位时间约127.5秒；对照方法分别为91.8%、586,386令牌和315.7秒。

evidenceClaims.claim: The retrieval stress test reports 100 percent recall as the memory bank grows from 159 to 659 memories.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，记忆库从159条扩展到659条时，检索压力测试保持100%召回。

evidenceClaims.claim: Replay admission checks lifecycle, artifact, reasoning, action schema, state, and flexible-input conditions.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究机制以生命周期、制品、推理、动作模式、状态和灵活输入条件决定重放准入。

evidenceClaims.claim: The state gate accepts 49 compatible and 46 partially compatible cases while rejecting 39 incompatible cases; flexible substitutions are accepted 50 of 50 and non-flexible mutations rejected 50 of 50.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，状态门禁接受49个兼容和46个部分兼容案例，拒绝39个不兼容案例；允许替换50次全部接受，不允许字段变化50次全部拒绝。

evidenceClaims.claim: The study is limited to GUI tasks and does not establish business authorization, exactly-once semantics, or external-effect safety.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究限于图形界面任务，未建立业务授权、恰好一次语义或外部效果安全。

evidenceClaims.claim: A reusable procedure should be treated as a versioned capability whose current eligibility is leased by fresh evidence.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，可复用程序应被视为版本化能力，其当前执行资格由新鲜证据临时证明。

evidenceClaims.claim: Replay admission, business authorization, and external-effect verification must remain separate evidence facts.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，重放准入、业务授权和外部效果验证必须保持为独立证据事实。

evidenceClaims.claim: State freshness, schema expiry, revocation propagation, concurrent replay, and effect reconciliation remain open.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 状态新鲜度、模式失效、撤销传播、并发重放和效果核对仍待研究。

candidates.title: Detection Does Not Mean the Threat Is Contained
candidates.title_zh: 发现威胁，不等于已经控制住
candidates.researchQuestion: 当一个长期运行的多智能体环境已经识别并警告了对抗性事件时，还需要哪些持久证据，才能证明威胁已经被控制、清除并恢复，而不只是被发现？
candidates.coreProposition: 检测只是安全响应的第一个事实；持续环境必须分别证明传播边界被封住、受污染状态被清除、已发生效果被处置、可信基线被恢复，并让所有派生状态都能追溯到污染血缘。

sections.heading: Risk Can Keep Growing After the Alert
sections.heading_zh: 一次警报之后，风险还会继续生长

sections.heading: Every World Warned, Yet Defense Remained Incomplete
sections.heading_zh: 所有系统都会警告，仍没有完整防御

sections.heading: Execution, Persistence, and Propagation Are Different Paths
sections.heading_zh: 执行、持久化与传播是三条不同路径

sections.heading: Security Response Needs Four Separate Facts
sections.heading_zh: 安全响应至少需要四个独立事实

sections.heading: A Trusted Role Does Not Clean Contaminated Provenance
sections.heading_zh: 可信角色不会洗白受污染来源

sections.heading: Recovery Is a Durable-State Closure Task
sections.heading_zh: 恢复是一项持久状态闭合任务

sections.heading: Preserve Unknown When Global Cleanliness Cannot Be Proved
sections.heading_zh: 无法证明全局干净时，应保留未知

evidenceClaims.claim: The study runs eight persistent worlds with ten agents each, totaling more than 850,000 model calls and nearly 50 billion tokens.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，研究运行八个持久世界，每个包含十个智能体，累计超过85万次模型调用和近500亿令牌。

evidenceClaims.claim: All seven exposed worlds issued warnings, yet none achieved complete defense across three stress events; the best reported phishing and misinformation results meet five of six and three of six criteria respectively.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，七个暴露世界都发出警告，却没有一个在三类压力事件中实现完整防御；最佳钓鱼和错误信息结果分别满足六项中的五项和六项中的三项。

evidenceClaims.claim: In one world, all ten agents interacted after recognizing and warning about the malicious link, with 151 execution operations among 602 interface interactions and retrieval again roughly 46 hours later.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，在一个世界中，十个智能体在识别并警告恶意链接后仍全部交互，602次界面交互中有151次执行操作，约46小时后链接再次被检索。

evidenceClaims.claim: The study observes malicious payloads stored in long-term memory and hostile content propagated inline between agents.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究观察到恶意载荷被写入长期记忆，并通过智能体之间的内联内容继续传播。

evidenceClaims.claim: Every exposed world changed state or published before verification, and no durable reusable misinformation-handling process was established.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 每个暴露世界都在验证前改变状态或发布内容，且没有建立持久、可复用的错误信息处置流程。

evidenceClaims.claim: The evidence comes from experimental worlds and does not establish universal enterprise behavior.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 证据来自实验世界，不建立普遍企业行为。

evidenceClaims.claim: Detection, containment, eradication, and recovery should remain four independently evidenced incident facts.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，检测、控制、清除与恢复应保持为四个独立取证的事件事实。

evidenceClaims.claim: Contamination lineage should connect durable state, derived artifacts, handoffs, and external effects.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，污染血缘应连接持久状态、派生制品、交接与外部效果。

evidenceClaims.claim: Sufficient eradication proof, cross-vendor incident identity, ordering of cleanup operations, and independent recovery acceptance remain open.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 充分清除证明、跨供应商事件身份、清理操作顺序与独立恢复验收仍待研究。
